stories.summary: Follow-up to the 10-05 piece on six journalists from the Egyptian outlet Matsda2sh who said they were tortured and made to read false confessions to camera (one clause). The new developments: the Journalists Syndicate has filed a formal complaint with the prosecution over the torture allegations, the Interior Ministry has publicly denied them, and the six remain in 15 days' remand detention under the Supreme State Security Prosecution, where a second round of questioning largely repeated the first, according to Hossam Bahgat of the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, whose lawyers defend them. Lead with the complaint and the denial side by side. The mechanism: a complaint puts the allegation on the record of the same prosecution that is holding the journalists, so say what it asks for (forensic examination, an investigation of named officers, as reported), what the charges against the six are, and when remand is next reviewed. The torture is an allegation by the detainees and their lawyers; the denial is the ministry's: attribute both. One clause of context: Rasha Azab was released on bail on 10-05 (covered). Mada Masr is the regional outlet and the only source, doing original reporting. Dateline Cairo.

stories.label: Groups Associated With India’s Far-Right Receive Millions Through US Donor-Advised Funds
stories.summary: A Bellingcat investigation finds that US non-profits whose founders or parent organisations are associated with India's Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), the Hindu nationalist movement behind the ruling BJP, or with initiatives it has endorsed, received millions of dollars in recent years through donor-advised funds. Lead with the total and the period, and name the largest recipients and the fund sponsors as Bellingcat does. The mechanism for a reader who follows money: a donor-advised fund takes the gift, gives the donor an immediate tax deduction, and later grants it onward under the sponsor's name, so the public filing shows the fund and not the person; say how Bellingcat traced the grants (tax filings), what the recipient groups do in the US and in India, and what the 'association' with the RSS consists of in each case, exactly as worded. Who it concerns: India's Muslims and other minorities targeted by RSS-linked campaigns, only as the report documents. Give every named group's and fund's response, or say it gave none. Single-source original investigation. No dateline: an investigation of filings, about money that lands in India, not a US-datelined event.

stories.label: State Police: Four states approve constitutional amendment bill - Presidential Group
stories.summary: Edo, Oyo, Osun and Rivers have become the first four Nigerian states to approve the constitutional amendment creating state police, which the National Assembly recently sent to all 36 state assemblies, according to Nnadubem Moghalu, secretary of the Presidential Working Group on the National Policing Bill. Lead with the four and the number still needed: a constitutional amendment requires two-thirds of the state assemblies, 24 of 36 (state the threshold as the report gives it). The mechanism: Nigeria has a single federal police force commanded from Abuja for more than 200 million people, and governors facing banditry, kidnapping and insurgency have no force of their own; say what the bill would let states do, what safeguards it carries, and what opponents fear (governors using police against rivals), as reported. Who it lands on: communities in the north-west and Middle Belt with the least protection now. Premium Times is the regional outlet and the only source. Dateline Abuja.

stories.label: Why is NASA bringing 7,500 contractors back to work as civil servants?
stories.summary: NASA is converting 7,500 contractor positions into civil-service jobs, reversing decades of outsourcing its engineering workforce. Lead with the number, the timetable and which centres and functions are affected, as Ars gives it. The mechanism: when the people who know how the hardware works are employed by vendors, the agency cannot judge what it is buying or run its own missions, so say what failures or reviews prompted the change, what it costs or saves, who decided it, and what the contractors that lose the head count say. Apollo flight director Gerry Griffin is the report's voice on why in-house expertise matters: quote him briefly, as his view. This is workforce policy, filed under politics, not a science finding. Single source. Dateline Washington. US dateline (3 of 3).

stories.label: Fed plans to overhaul bank supervision responsibilities, Bowman says
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve plans to take bank examinations away from its twelve regional reserve bank presidents and run supervision under a model 'more accountable to Washington', its top regulatory official, Michelle Bowman, said on Tuesday. Lead with the change and who loses authority. The mechanism: regional Fed presidents are not political appointees, so moving supervision to the Board in Washington puts the oversight of US banks closer to officials the president nominates; say what Bowman gives as the reason (the 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, supervised by the San Francisco Fed, is tagged), what the new structure is, when it takes effect and whether it needs Congress, and what critics say about independence and lighter-touch oversight. One clause of context: the Fed opened a review of private-credit risks (covered 10-05). This is about supervision, not interest rates: do not frame it as a rate story. Single source. Dateline Washington. US dateline (1 of 3).

stories.label: AI could reduce poverty, but poor Africans risk being left behind - World Bank
stories.summary: The World Bank's October 2026 Africa Economic Update says artificial intelligence could expand the digital economies of Nigeria and other African countries and cut poverty, but that poor households risk being shut out of the gains. Lead with the report's hardest numbers, as Premium Times gives them: its growth forecast for sub-Saharan Africa and Nigeria, and the gaps it measures in electricity, internet access, devices and skills. The mechanism: AI's benefits reach people through connectivity, power and literacy that the poorest lack, so a technology that raises productivity for the connected can widen the gap with everyone else; say what the Bank recommends governments do and what it would cost. State the Bank's interest plainly in a clause: it is a lender that finances the digital infrastructure it recommends. Premium Times is the regional outlet and the only source. Dateline Abuja or Washington as the report supports; if neither, no dateline.

stories.label: Shoes may change the structure of our ankle bones | New Scientist
stories.summary: A study finds that wearing shoes is linked to slight changes in the spongy internal bone of the human ankle, which matters because fossil ankle bones have long been compared with those of modern, shoe-wearing people to work out how upright walking evolved. Lead with the finding and its consequence for the fossil record: the modern baseline may be skewed. The mechanism: trabecular bone remodels through life in response to the loads placed on it, so the talus of a habitually barefoot person records a different pattern of use; say which populations were compared, how many individuals, how the bone was imaged, how large the difference is, and which claims about early hominin gait the authors think need revisiting. Name the journal and the limits the researchers state (New Scientist's own wording is 'linked to', not 'causes'). No dateline: reporting on a published study.

stories.label: Mistral Large 4
stories.summary: The French AI company Mistral released Mistral Large 4, its new flagship model; the announcement drew more than 1,000 points and 677 comments on Hacker News. Lead with what Mistral actually claims, from its own page: benchmark results and against which rivals, context length, price per token, the licence and whether the weights are open, and where it can be run. The mechanism for a developer: Mistral sells 'sovereign' AI, a frontier-class model that European governments and firms can host on their own infrastructure outside US jurisdiction, so say what deployment options and customers the announcement names. Every performance figure is the vendor's own claim: attribute it to Mistral and say that independent evaluation has not yet been reported, unless the page cites one. The source is a company announcement, so write only what the fetched page supports and add no numbers from memory. Dateline Paris.

stories.label: Trump Mobile customers' data dumped - and some never even received their gold device
stories.summary: A ransomware group calling itself BYOD claims to have breached Trump Mobile, the Trump-branded phone business, and has leaked data on 3,615 people: names, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses and order details. Lead with the leak, the count and what it exposes, including The Register's finding that some customers in the dump never received the phone they paid for. The mechanism for a technical reader: say how the attackers claim to have got in and what was demanded, whether the company or its vendors confirmed the breach and notified customers, and what the order records show about deliveries. Accountability: this is a consumer business licensed by the sitting president's family company, so say who operates it and who is legally responsible for the data, as reported. The breach is the criminals' claim until confirmed: attribute it, and say what The Register verified itself. Drop the outlet's jokey tone. Single source. US dateline (2 of 3).

stories.label: The EU Extends SALTO Deadline Again as Themis Hop Test Slips
stories.summary: The European Commission has again extended its SALTO reusable-launcher project, now to the end of 2026, because the first 'hop' of Themis, Europe's reusable rocket demonstrator, has slipped another three months. Lead with the new deadline and how many times and by how long the project has now been extended, as the Commission's project database shows. The mechanism for a technical reader: a hop test is a short vertical take-off and landing of a single stage, the step SpaceX's Grasshopper made in 2012, so say what Themis is (engine, size, who builds it, where it will fly), what has held it up, and what the EU has spent. Why it matters in one clause: Europe launches its own government satellites on expendable rockets while reusable ones set the price of reaching orbit. Single specialist source. Dateline Brussels, or Kiruna if the report places the test site there.
